The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d47a50531670a4f9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every sufficiently large integer m, the vertex set V in (3.12) admits a negative-type semimetric d with the following properties. Its chart maps vs(θ), defined almost everywhere on U = (−2, 2)m, satisfy ⏐ ⏐d(vs(θ), vt(η)) − c∗ √ m |θ − η| ⏐ ⏐ ≤ Cr (θ, η ∈ U) (4.5) whenever the labels are defined, where r = m−8. For labels in the same chart, ∥x − x′ ∥1 = τ =⇒ d((s, x), (s, x′ )) ≤ Cτ m N (log m)2 . (4.6) Moreover, |V | ≤ exp(Cm log m), diam(V, d) ≤ Cm, (4.7) and, for independent uniform θ, η ∈ T = (−1, 1)m, Ed(v1(θ), v1(η)) ≥ cm. (4.8) Here N = m6, τ = m−2000, and all constants are absolute.
